## NID Verify 1.3.0

- Reads your NID profile in English and Bangla, with a fresh, secure portal session every time.
- A clear four-step verifying screen: Reading your NID profile, Checking your details, Saving to your account, Signing you out securely.
- Signs you out of the NID portal automatically after verification.
- More time on slow networks: the session is extended once you log in.
- Clear messages in English and Bangla when something needs a retry.
- Safer updates: every update is signed and checked before it installs.
